↗ ex:4-19 5-4. Show that the image of the curve $\beta : \left( {-\pi ,\pi }\right) \rightarrow {\mathbb {R}}^{2}$ of Example 4.19 is not an embedded submanifold of ${\mathbb {R}}^{2}$ . [Be careful: this is not the same as showing that $\beta $ is not an embedding.] \end{exercise}
